messages.text: The first port is in place. I’m compiling the entrypoint and running a broad differential matrix against the official binary, then I’ll patch mismatches.

commands.commandLine:
powershell.exe -Command "sh .\\compile.sh; Get-ChildItem executable* | Select-Object Name,Length; @'
import subprocess,pathlib
ref=pathlib.Path('REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip()
ours='executable.cmd'
cases=[
 [],['-1'],['-a','-1'],['-aa','-1'],['-A','-1'],['-l','--color=never','--icons=never'],['-lh','--color=never','--icons=never'],
 ['-T','--color=never','--icons=never'],['-T','-l','--color=never','--icons=never'],['-R','-1'],['-R','-l','--color=never','--icons=never'],
 ['-1','--sort=name'],['-1','--sort=Name'],['-1','--sort=extension'],['-1','--sort=size'],['-1','--sort=modified'],['-1','--sort=none'],
 ['-1','--group-directories-first'],['-1','-r'],['-d','-1'],['-D','-1'],['-f','-1'],
 ['--grid','--width=40','--color=never','--icons=never'],['--grid','-x','--width=40','--color=never','--icons=never'],
 ['-lB','--color=never','--icons=never'],['-lb','--color=never','--icons=never'],['-l','--time-style=iso','--color=never','--icons=never'],
 ['-1','--no-quotes'],['-1','--classify=always']]
fixtures=['probe-fixture','format-fixture']
for fixture in fixtures:
 for args in cases:
  cmdargs=[*args,fixture]
  a=subprocess.run([ref,*cmdargs],capture_output=True)
  b=subprocess.run([ours,*cmdargs],capture_output=True,shell=True)
  if (a.returncode,a.stdout,a.stderr)"'!=(b.returncode,b.stdout,b.stderr):
   print('"'MISMATCH',fixture,args)
   print('REF',a.returncode,repr(a.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace')),repr(a.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace')))
   print('OUR',b.returncode,repr(b.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace')),repr(b.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace')))
'@ | python -"
